svg.text: The piece runs as one long chain from problem to method to evidence to practice, with a convergence in the middle
where several empirical findings all support one claim about synergy, and a fork near the end into forward-looking

g.text: A chain from the problem (no good way to measure neural computation) through the PID method to a cluster of findings
that all converge on 'synergy marks information processing', then branching into practical limits and future

g.title: How do brains process information? — New recording tech and new analysis methods now make this tractable. — → spya-yb735k
Mutual information vs. transfer entropy — connectivity vs. flow — → spya-ygkzd8
Flow alone can't show how inputs combine — → spya-dhy39x
Partial Information Decomposition — redundant / unique / synergistic — Splits joint mutual information into non-overlapping pieces via a lattice and a chosen redundancy measure. — → spya-u0wm5e
Rich-club neurons hold most synergy — → spya-e3ghxj
Recurrent links raise synergy, feedback doesn't — → spya-p8by2y
Synergy peaks at moderate input correlation — → spya-zfs2z7
In behaving monkeys, synergy shifts with task — → spya-aqcngt
Caveats: culture data, bivariate estimates — → spya-vjzxxm
Synergy = where computation happens — → spya-cc282b
Practical limits: data type, sample size, tools — → spya-kmgwhs
Future: local PID, multi-target (ΦID) — → spya-zz5xxs
Neurons compute on patterns, not just sums — → spya-rc5z33

g.text: A ladder: from the puzzle that parts don't sum to the whole, through the two-neuron case, up to the general lattice,
which still needs an arbitrary choice of redundancy measure to compute.

g.title: Whole ≠ sum of parts — → spya-u0wm5e
Whole > parts: synergy — → spya-e94ury
Whole < parts: redundancy — → spya-e94ury
Two-parent case: four unknown atoms, three equations — → spya-y7wdb7
General lattice of source subsets — Mobius inversion over a redundancy function gives every partial information atom. — → spya-k378fv
No agreed redundancy measure; pick per data type — → spya-d2quz5

g.text: Several independent findings, from cortical cultures and from behaving monkeys, all converge on the same claim: synergy
concentrates where the real information processing happens.

g.title: 512-electrode recordings, thousands of triads — → spya-cc282b
Synergy tracks feedforward transfer entropy — → spya-kqkb58
Rich-club triads: 88% of network synergy — → spya-fud8q3
Recurrent > feedback for raising synergy — → spya-sd9fzd
Synergy peaks at ~7% of max correlation — → spya-ybmve2
Bivariate TE overstates edges; culture ≠ in vivo — → spya-j4cy9j
Macaques: synergy/redundancy shift by task epoch — → spya-t8fayf
Synergy = behaviorally shaped computation — → spya-b32ecw
